media:group.media:title: Mobile Networks Defence Day 2026
media:group.media:description:
Ericsson, together with Play, Asseco and Cellnex hosted the first edition of Mobile Networks Defence Day in Kraków, Poland.
The event explored how modern dual-use technologies can strengthen national security, resilience and the protection of critical infrastructure.
One of the highlights was a live demonstration of Ericsson Sensing technology, showcasing how mobile network radios can also function as radars to detect drones.

media:group.media:title: OKINAWA Digital Lab 2026
media:group.media:description:
Ericsson uses the power of connectivity and technology to contribute to society.
In collaboration with Okinawa Cellular, we brought Ericsson’s Digital Lab to Miyakojima for the first time! The children on this remote island proved once again that they are digital natives. Even those who had never programmed before quickly got the hang of it and made steady progress. I was truly impressed by their ability to learn and absorb new things.

entry.title: エリクソン150周年記念動画 Our Stories: Rebecka

media:group.media:title: エリクソン150周年記念動画 Our Stories: Rebecka
media:group.media:description:
テクノロジーに私たちのために何をしてもらいたいのか。社会の中で、私たちの生活の一部としてどのような役割を担ってほしいのか。💡
この「Our Stories」動画では、スウェーデンのエリクソンで主任研究員を務めるRebeckaが、モバイルフォンのその先にあるものについて考えながら、自身の仕事への情熱を語ります。
研究者として働く中で、どのようなテクノロジーを開発するのかを理解するだけでなく、私たちに本当に必要なテクノロジーとは何かを見極めることも重要だと学びました。
AIグラスなどのAIデバイスから、ネットワークを構築する新たな方法まで、私たちは新たな地平へと向かっています。まだまだ探求すべきことはたくさんあります。🔎
動画を視聴して、エリクソン150周年記念についてさらに詳しくご覧ください。 http://m.eric.sn/ixcU50ZKEue
#Ericsson150 #OurStories

media:group.media:title: Ericsson Our Stories - Rebecka
media:group.media:description:
What do we want technology to be doing for us, to be part of our lives in society? 💡
In this Our Stories video, Rebecka, Principal Researcher at Ericsson in Sweden, shares her passions for her work, reflecting on what comes after mobile phones.
Working as a researcher, she learned that it’s not only about understanding what kind of technology we develop but also trying to figure out what technology we need.
From AI devices, such as AI glasses, to finding new ways to build a network, we’re reaching new horizons. There are still many things to be explored. 🔎
Watch the video and learn more about our 150-year jubilee: http://m.eric.sn/ixcU50ZKEue
#Ericsson150 #OurStories

entry.title: Technology and Telecom Trends 2026: AI’s demand on networks

media:group.media:title: Technology and Telecom Trends 2026: AI’s demand on networks
media:group.media:description:
AI is placing new demands on networks, changing who and what uses them and what they need to deliver.
In Technology and Telecom Trends 2026, Ericsson CTO Erik Ekudden presents four transformational shifts shaping the network into an intelligent fabric.
Programmable, autonomous and AI-native by design, the intelligent fabric represents a shift in how networks will be defined: infrastructure that does not just carry data, but also senses, predicts and acts in real time.
The four trends explore Physical AI, Security in transformation, The programmable world and Heterogeneous compute.
The decisions made in the next two to three years will determine how this transformation unfolds.
🔗 Read the full report and shape what comes next: https://www.ericsson.com/en/reports-and-papers/ericsson-technology-review/articles/technology-trends-2026?utm_medium=social_organic&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=gfmc_cspne_tech_trends_2026_20260924

entry.title: If Ericsson’s legacy had a sound, what would it be?

media:group.media:title: If Ericsson’s legacy had a sound, what would it be?
media:group.media:description:
For 150 years, Ericsson has helped connect people, industries, and communities across the world, shaping the way we communicate, collaborate, and imagine what comes next.
So, what does a century and a half of innovation, partnership, and progress sound like?
This new song and video transform Ericsson’s story into an experience you can hear, see, and feel. Created from real Ericsson sounds and shaped with Pierre Riddez, composer and producer, the track brings 150 years of ingenuity, connection, and progress to life with elegance and emotion. It honors the people behind our journey while reflecting the ambition that keeps us reaching new horizons together.
One thing is clear: our story is still playing, with new ideas, new voices, and new possibilities adding depth to the rhythm of our next chapter. 💙
Visit http://m.eric.sn/iIaY50ZNmkP for more
#Ericsson150 #TeamEricsson
